excerpts.text: Detail of the Emancipation Proclamation, "Authorized Edition".
President Lincoln issued the final Emancipation Proclamation on January 1, 1863.

In witness whereof, I have hereunto set my hand and caused the seal of the United States to be affixed.

Done at the City of Washington, this first day of January, in the year of our Lord one thousand eight hundred and sixty three, and of the Independence of the United States of America the eighty-seventh.

assessment.rationale: Span 14 states Lincoln issued the final Emancipation Proclamation on January 1, 1863. Span 56 says 'Done at the City of Washington, this first day of January, in the year of our Lord one thousand eight hundred and sixty three' — confirming Washington, D.C. as the location.
assessment.provenance_note: Span 14 gives the date; span 56 explicitly places the signing in the City of Washington on that date.
